description: Test your x402 client end to end without buying anything else: pay a real price and get an echo back with what we saw (network, amount, payer). Use it once before wiring a paid tool into an agent. $0.004 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: x402_payment_test
